metadata.source_scope: Locally authored controlled edits: each prompt omits the recorded withheld requirement from its full version. Exploratory pilot, not spontaneous user prompts.

cases.prompt: Summarize the attached article in exactly three bullet points.
cases.withheld_requirement: The article text is: The team launched a new support portal in June. Median response time fell from six hours to four hours, while ticket volume rose by 10%.
cases.full_prompt: Summarize the attached article in exactly three bullet points. The article text is: The team launched a new support portal in June. Median response time fell from six hours to four hours, while ticket volume rose by 10%.

cases.prompt: Using the sales spreadsheet I mentioned, identify the top three revenue drivers and report each percentage.
cases.withheld_requirement: The spreadsheet rows are: Product A, $120,000, up $20,000; Product B, $80,000, up $15,000; Product C, $50,000, up $5,000.
cases.full_prompt: Using the sales spreadsheet I mentioned, identify the top three revenue drivers and report each percentage. The spreadsheet rows are: Product A, $120,000, up $20,000; Product B, $80,000, up $15,000; Product C, $50,000, up $5,000.

cases.prompt: Fix the failing login test in my repository and explain the change in two sentences.
cases.withheld_requirement: The failing test is tests/test_login.py::test_expired_session; it expects a 401 response for an expired token but currently receives 200.
cases.full_prompt: Fix the failing login test in my repository and explain the change in two sentences. The failing test is tests/test_login.py::test_expired_session; it expects a 401 response for an expired token but currently receives 200.

cases.prompt: Write a concise onboarding guide for new support agents covering account setup and escalation.
cases.full_prompt: Write a concise onboarding guide for new support agents covering account setup and escalation. Return a numbered checklist.

cases.prompt: Plan a migration from PostgreSQL 14 to PostgreSQL 16 for a production web app. Include a rollback step.
cases.withheld_requirement: Keep production downtime under five minutes.
cases.full_prompt: Plan a migration from PostgreSQL 14 to PostgreSQL 16 for a production web app. Include a rollback step. Keep production downtime under five minutes.

cases.prompt: Implement a CSV importer that skips malformed rows and reports the number imported.
cases.withheld_requirement: Done means the existing importer test suite passes.
cases.full_prompt: Implement a CSV importer that skips malformed rows and reports the number imported. Done means the existing importer test suite passes.
